L01_self_loop_to_phi.description: Self-loop: x = 1 + 1/x iteration converges to phi

L02_phi_to_pac.description: phi^2 = phi + 1 is PAC conservation (split ratios sum to 1)

L03_pac_to_ade.description: PAC recursion -> ADE root lattice (spectral radius phi)

L04_ade_to_complement.description: Complement operation well-defined on ADE diagrams

L06_weyl_to_sl2c.description: Weyl Z_2 action on su(2); SEC complexification -> sl(2,C)

L08_so31_to_metric.description: Killing form signature (3,3) encodes Minkowski metric

L09_metric_to_c.description: Rapidity tanh bound -> speed of light as structural limit

T1.derivation_summary: self-loop -> phi (iteration) -> PAC (phi^2=phi+1) -> ADE (root lattice) -> complement (vertex removal) -> parallax (observer-dependent views) -> Weyl Z_2 + SEC -> SL(2,C) -> SO(3,1) (Lorentz) -> ds^2 (Killing metric) -> c (tanh bound) -> proper time (cosh dilation)

predictions.name: Complement spectrum uniquely determines vertex orbit in ADE graphs
predictions.value: complement_spectrum(G,v) is a complete orbit invariant for ADE
predictions.uncertainty: Proven for all ADE types to rank 8; conjecture for general graphs
predictions.basis: exp_01: complement spectra distinguish all automorphism orbits
predictions.falsifiable_by: Find an ADE graph where two vertices in different orbits have identical complement spectra

predictions.name: Parallax is monotonically related to observer distance
predictions.value: parallax(obs1, obs2, target) increases with graph_distance(obs1, obs2)

superposition.analogy: Superposition = sum over all possible complement-views weighted by structure
superposition.mechanism: For a graph G and target v, each observer position o gives a different complement-view. Before observation, all views are simultaneously valid -- this IS superposition.

measurement.description: Selecting an observer vertex collapses complement-views to one
measurement.mechanism: The act of observing FROM a specific vertex selects one complement-view out of many. The irreversibility comes from the structural asymmetry: once a position is selected, the view is determined.

entanglement.description: Correlated complement-views from structurally related vertices
entanglement.mechanism: Vertices in the same automorphism orbit have identical complement spectra. Observing one immediately constrains the other. The correlation is structural, not causal.

m14_dependencies.name: Complement-view probability measure
m14_dependencies.description: Need a natural probability measure on the space of complement-views for a given graph. Likely related to the complement spectrum -- eigenvalue magnitudes as weights.

m14_dependencies.name: Complement-view interference
m14_dependencies.description: Need to show that complement-views can interfere (constructive/destructive addition of spectral components). This requires complex-valued complement operations, extending real-valued graph spectra.

m14_dependencies.name: Complement uncertainty relation
m14_dependencies.description: Non-commuting complement operations should yield an uncertainty principle. If two graph properties cannot be simultaneously determined by complement-views, this gives Heisenberg uncertainty.

honest_failures.description: Coherence limit may not scale exactly as c for all graph families. The deformation bound is graph-dependent, and mapping it precisely to the physical speed of light requires a correspondence that has not been rigorously established.
honest_failures.implication: c-from-complement is suggestive, not yet a derivation

honest_failures.description: Rapidity-deformation correspondence assumes the deformation parameter maps linearly to Lorentz boost parameter. This works for SL(2,C) but the discrete-to-continuous transition may introduce corrections.
honest_failures.implication: Discrete corrections expected at Planck scale

honest_failures.description: Curvature-density correlation demonstrated on artificial density-lump graphs, not on physically realized ADE graphs. ADE graphs are too small for a clean gradient signal.
honest_failures.implication: Need larger, more physical graph models for curvature tests
